interface.shortDescription: Evidence-first workflows with Luna delegated workers for serious codebase work.
interface.longDescription: Fable-5 for Codex provides skills for audits, deep reviews, fact checks, codebase understanding, design options, and repo-wide sweeps. When GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra is selected for the parent, it remains the coordinator while GPT-5.6 Luna medium handles bounded subagents by default. Each workflow emphasizes ECF-style run contracts, source-grounded mapping, independent lenses, verified findings, rejected-candidate preservation, coverage notes, explicit unknowns, and honest Workflow Traces.
defaultPrompt: With GPT-5.6 Sol + Ultra selected, use $fable-audit with Luna medium workers and an ECF run contract.
Use $fable-understand with an ECF run contract to explain boot flow.
